meta.source: Smart bin system exports in AZZA STORE SEC\WM002 MAP APP: 'BinDetails_20260904092806652.xlsx' (the RFID bin register, exported 04 Sep 2026 09:28) and 'Route (8).xlsx' (the route register)
meta.status: REPORTED by the smart bin system. A position is the one registered at deployment, not survey verified. A collection read is the RFID reader on a truck reading the tag: a bin can be emptied without a read, so a bin with no recent read either missed a collection or was not read, and the export cannot tell which.
meta.ageRule: days from the last collection read to the export (04 Sep 2026 09:28), not to today: the file is a snapshot

routes.note: no geometry and no link to the bins in the export; distance and duration are the values set in the register (123 routes carry 300 km and 167 carry 660 minutes), not measured

gaps: Positions for the bins the programme counts as placed but the RFID register does not hold: see coverage. Owner: the Bin Maintenance unit, which runs the register.
95 bins carry the system's Dubai default as their last read position: their last read has no real position. Owner: the system administrator.
No collection schedule, collection point or route is recorded against any bin (the columns are empty in the export), so a bin cannot be tied to a route from this file.
meta.rowFormat: [lon, lat, binNumber, serial, epc, capacity, deployed, lastRead, lastReadLon, lastReadLat, readOnExportDay, washed, areaName, namedArea, groundM, readFromRegisteredM]
